what_this_is: Four cases where the answer already exists in the published literature, so this project can be shown to be wrong today with no wet lab. The predictions were committed to git BEFORE the data.

verdicts.predicted: positive sign of the charge/duration relationship
verdicts.refuted_if: the point estimate of Spearman rho is negative

verdicts.predicted: Spearman rho in 0.50-0.85 with permutation p < 0.05 at n >= 12
verdicts.why: the pre-registered n >= 12 is not reachable from the sourced record: 9 rows carry a species-maximum duration and 11 carry any sourced duration. The result at n = 9 is shown and is underpowered, not a pass or a fail of the prediction as written.
verdicts.underpowered_result: would have been outside the band

verdicts.predicted: Spearman(charge, log duration) exceeds Pearson(charge, raw minutes)
verdicts.refuted_if: Pearson on raw minutes >= Spearman on log duration

verdicts.predicted: terrestrial anchors sit at the low-charge end with a narrower spread than the divers
verdicts.refuted_if: any strictly terrestrial mammal exceeds the median diver charge
verdicts.observed: anchor range [0.362,1.118] vs diver range [-0.068,4.116], diver median 3.24; anchors above it: none

verdicts.predicted: directional only: sequence-only charge recovers the relationship LESS well than the published surface quantity
verdicts.why: the premise was wrong. Z_Mb as published is a sum over ALL ionisable groups at pH 6.5, not a solvent-exposed subset, so there is no "surface" quantity for the sequence-only one to fall short of. The exposed-subset variant computed here is an ADDITION to the published quantity, not a reproduction of it.
verdicts.exposed_subset_result: exposed-residue charge gives Spearman rho = -0.6587 at n = 9, against -0.6303 for the sequence sum at n = 9

verdicts.predicted: opsin lambda-max mean absolute error between 8 and 25 nm
verdicts.refuted_if: MAE < 8 nm (rules transfer better than expected) or > 25 nm (barely at all)
verdicts.observed: MAE 2.92 nm to the nearest band edge, 4.67 nm against the band midpoint as a point prediction (n = 12)
verdicts.why: the site rules transfer considerably better than predicted

verdicts.predicted: deep-sea rows will have the blue shift UNDER-predicted: predicted lambda-max redder than measured, and of opposite sign to the shallow rows
verdicts.refuted_if: the mean signed error on deep rows is <= 0, or its sign matches the shallow rows
verdicts.observed: deep/mesopelagic n = 8, mean signed error -2.13 nm; other rows n = 4, -2.75 nm
verdicts.why: wrong twice: the deep rows are predicted slightly BLUER than measured, not redder, and the two groups share a sign rather than differing

verdicts.predicted: at least one tuned site falls in an alignment gap and is reported unreadable
verdicts.refuted_if: every tuned site is cleanly readable on every row
verdicts.observed: no row failed to align at a tuned site; 2 row(s) instead carry a substitution whose SHIFT VALUE could not be retrieved, so their band is narrow for the wrong reason
verdicts.why: the prediction named the wrong failure mode. Alignment was not the problem; an unretrievable shift value was, and the module reports it rather than letting a narrow band read as confidence.

verdicts.predicted: Spearman(predicted, measured) > 0.6 even while MAE stays above 8 nm
verdicts.why: the rank-order half of the prediction holds; the MAE half does not, so the conjunction as stated was half right

verdicts.predicted: fewer than six mutually comparable TTX values exist in the record - same numbering convention, same channel, same class of expression system
verdicts.refuted_if: six or more mutually comparable values can be assembled
verdicts.observed: the largest mutually comparable group has 18 values (rNaV1.4, Rattus norvegicus, Xenopus laevis oocytes, two-electrode voltage clamp, TTX-IC50), 1 group(s) of six or more
verdicts.why: but the concern survives in a sharper form: those values are a mutational scan of a SENSITIVE mammalian channel, not measurements of the convergent natural variants. For the lineages that actually evolved resistance the comparable set is three.

verdicts.predicted: fewer than 40% of host x capability cells admissible
verdicts.why: refuted by 0.2 percentage points - and the prediction was ill-posed. The refusal fraction is a property of which hosts and capabilities were written down, both chosen partly to cover every mechanism class, so it is not a base rate.

zmb_convention.quote: We calculated Z_Mb as the sum of the charge of all ionizable groups in myoglobin at pH = 6.5 by modelling Mb primary structures onto the tertiary structure and using published, conserved, site-specific ionisation constants (McLellan, 1984; Mirceta et al., 2013).
zmb_convention.quote_location: Methods, section headed "Calculation of myoglobin net surface charge and electrophoretic mobility".
zmb_convention.verified_how: Retrieved the full text XML from Europe PMC (REST, /PMC8205494/fullTextXML) on 2026-11-07, stripped tags, and read the Methods section heading "Calculation of myoglobin net surface charge and electrophoretic mobility". The convention quoted in ZMB_CONVENTION is verbatim from that section. PMID/DOI confirmed by PubMed MCP id conversion from PMC8205494.
zmb_convention.scope_of_the_sum: all ionizable groups - NOT a solvent-exposed subset, despite the name "net surface charge"
what_could_NOT_be_reproduced: The structure-mediated step. "Modelling primary structures onto the tertiary structure" cannot be done from a sequence, and this module takes sequences.

The site-specific ionisation constants. They are in McLellan 1984's tables, which were not retrieved for this file (only its abstract was). Without them, a per-residue-type pKa set is a substitute, not an approximation.
There is no reported Zmb value for any species anywhere in this file, because none was retrieved from a methods section or a data table.
zmb_convention.what_the_abstract_of_mirceta_2013_does_s: That elevated myoglobin net surface charge is the reported adaptive signature in diving mammals and is mechanistically linked with maximal myoglobin concentration, over a 130-species mammalian phylogeny. That is a statement of the finding, retrieved in full. It is not a method.
zmb_convention.therefore: zmbSurfaceCharge returns no key holding a number called Zmb. It returns named sequence-only variants and requires the caller to choose one by name.

stats.what_a_hit_does_not_show: A row landing inside the band is weak evidence: the band is wide by construction, it is built from values fitted on an overlapping set of species, and rows with unquantified substitutions have bands that are too narrow for the wrong reason. Read the misses, not the hits.

the_hard_part.headline: Site-based lambda-max prediction looks like physics and acts like a correlation. The five-site rule is real, it is well measured, and it is a statement about substitutions IN THE BACKGROUNDS THEY WERE MEASURED IN. Every step from there to "predict this pigment from its sequence" is a step the data does not license.
epistasis: The site rule is additive. Its own authors needed a non-additive term to fit it: in Yokoyama & Radlwimmer 2001 the singles S180A and H197Y are -7 and -28 nm, so additivity predicts -35 nm for the pair, and the fitted double term is +11 nm. The interaction is bigger than four of the five single effects.

The same substitution has different magnitudes in different species measured in ONE paper with ONE assay. Sugawara et al. 2005 measured D83N at about 8 nm in Baileychromis centropomoides and at 2-4 nm - "close to the measurement error" - in other cichlids. Same substitution, same site, same laboratory, same instrument, a factor of three.

A292S is reported at -14 nm in one background (Sugawara et al. 2005, in Oreochromis niloticus) and at about -10 nm as a general statement (Yokoyama et al. 2008). Both are in SITE_SHIFTS and neither is averaged away.

The hardest version: Nathans 1990 built bovine mutants at 83 and 122 and found NO significant spectral effect, concluding in the paper itself that these residues do not tune the spectrum. Two of the five canonical sites were measured as inert in the one background everyone numbers from. The rule and its counterexample are the same literature.

The magnitude of opsin epistasis has been measured directly, in a different pigment class: of the 5,040 orderings of the seven mutations that convert an ancestral mammalian SWS1 pigment from UV- to blue-sensitive, Yokoyama et al. 2014 find 4,008 pass through a dehydrated nonfunctional pigment. Roughly four fifths of paths through a seven-step mutational space are blocked. Independence of sites is not a mild approximation in this protein family.
numbering_drift: Every site label in this file is a bovine P02699 coordinate, and no sequence here is bovine. Fish RH1 sequences in MEASURED run 308-354 residues against bovine's 348, so a bare integer does not transfer and an offset constant would be wrong for at least some rows.

This module therefore aligns rather than offsets, and reports alignmentQuality() with every mapping. In the transmembrane core, where all the rule sites sit, the alignment is unambiguous. It is not reliable in the termini.

Four entries in SEQUENCES are explicitly PARTIAL (the three cichlids at 308 residues, and two of the quarantined entries at 287 and 300). A partial entry can silently fail to cover a rule site, which is why bovineSiteResidue() returns `covered: false` and a reason instead of a residue.

The literature itself drifts: Hunt et al. 2001 name site 208, while the RH1/RH2 literature from the same period names 207. Nothing here resolves that; both numbers appear in EXTENDED_SITES exactly as their sources give them.
method_differences: MEASURED mixes three assays. Nine rows are in vitro regeneration with 11-cis-retinal; of those, two are DARK-LIGHT DIFFERENCE SPECTRA where the paper states a dark spectrum was not obtained. One row is microspectrophotometry of rod photoreceptors. One is a photobleaching difference spectrum in digitonin with hydroxylamine.

The disagreement between assays is not small relative to what we are predicting. Bovine rhodopsin is 498 nm in Nathans 1990 and the ancestral rhodopsins are 500 nm in Yokoyama et al. 2008; that 2 nm is comparable to the whole measured effect of D83N in most of the cichlids. The prediction baseline is an interval for exactly this reason.

Chromophore identity is a further confound this file does not control. Sugawara et al. 2005 assume an A1-derived chromophore from an A1:A2 ratio measured in two species; MSP of a live retina measures whatever chromophore that retina is using. An A1/A2 difference moves lambda-max by more than several of the site effects.

Stated precisions differ by row. The cichlid rows carry +/-1 to +/-2 nm from the paper; the Yokoyama rows are printed as integers with no interval. A residual of 3 nm means different things in the two halves of the table.
overlapping_fit: The site rules were fitted on sequence/lambda-max pairs from a set of species that OVERLAPS the set scored here. Yokoyama et al. 2008 is both the source of eight MEASURED rows and the source of several SITE_SHIFTS values. Scoring the rule on those rows is closer to measuring the fit's residual than to testing a prediction.

This is a leakage problem with no clean fix inside this data, because the comparative literature on RH1 is small and the same laboratories produced both the sequences and the rules. The honest statement is that retroValidate() reports IN-SAMPLE residuals for part of its table, and the per-row `source` field is what lets a reader see which rows those are.
It gets worse in the direction that flatters the method: the rows whose provenance is cleanest are the ones from the paper that also supplied the rule.

The one same-species pair in the table - Lepidopus fitchi RH1-A at 507 nm and RH1-B at 481 nm, 26 nm apart with the genetic background as close as comparative data gets - is the single most informative comparison here, and it comes from that same paper.
the_hard_part.and_the_rule_was_never_claimed_to_do_thi: Hunt et al. 2001 sequenced rod opsins from 28 deep-sea species and stated plainly that the clustering of lambda-max values "does not involve a common subset of these substitutions in the different species". The people who built the site lists reported, in the abstract, that the sites do not combine the same way twice. The over-claim is downstream of them, and this module is downstream of them, so the over-claim would be ours.
what_would_make_this_a_real_benchmark: A held-out species set measured after the rule was fixed, by one assay, with one chromophore, reported with intervals.
Single-mutant values for E122Q and M207L in a stated RH1 background, as two numbers each - the two conspicuous nulls here.
The same substitution measured in five or more backgrounds, which would turn shiftBand() from a two-value range into a distribution and make the band mean something.
Resolvable accessions for the dropped rows, starting with the coelacanth RH1 - the most-cited blue shift in this literature and absent from our scoring table.

summary.headline_measurement: Thamnophis sirtalis NaV1.4 allele NaV1.4-LVNV: TTX Kd 13000 +/- 1800 nM (n=11) against 50 +/- 5.2 nM (n=13) for the ancestral allele, both native snake channels in Xenopus oocytes, cut-open voltage clamp (hague_2018, DOI 10.1002/evl3.76). The source states 260-fold and 13000/50 = 260.
summary.headline_warning: At the same locus, in a congener, NaV1.4 genotype explains 23% of whole-animal TTX-resistance variation (feldman_2010, DOI 10.1098/rspb.2010.0748). No row in this file carries a whole-animal fold-shift.

quantitative-target-exists.because: 30 measured values across TTX-IC50, TTX-Kd, STX-IC50, activation and fast-inactivation V-half, AP block threshold, variance explained and sequence identity, each with the unit its source reported. The headline target is 13000 +/- 1800 nM against 50 +/- 5.2 nM on a native snake channel.
quantitative-target-exists.what_would_raise_it: Nothing; it is as high as this axis goes.

sensitive-control-in-the-same-assay.because: At the muscle level, yes and cleanly: 0.025 uM blocks Ambystoma mavortium and 300 uM fails to block Taricha granulosa, in one paper. At the channel level the sensitive anchors are wild-type rat channels, which are a different clade from every resistant lineage here, and the designated sensitive fish control has no retrievable number at all.
sensitive-control-in-the-same-assay.what_would_raise_it: A TTX IC50 for the Danio rerio channels measured alongside the pufferfish channels in one system.

convergence-is-independent.because: Five convergence sets, each with a retrieved source asserting independence. The strongest is intraspecific: hague_2017 states that the identical I1561V in the two Thamnophis sirtalis lineages is not identical by descent.
convergence-is-independent.what_would_raise_it: Nothing; it is as high as this axis goes.

cross-study-commensurability.because: Four expression systems, two estimands (IC50 and Kd), two kinds of error bar, several rows with none, and a measured 1.35x disagreement between two labs about the unmutated rat channel. Substitution effects of 1.5- to 2-fold are the same size as that disagreement.
cross-study-commensurability.what_would_raise_it: One lab, one system, one reference channel, all the substitutions.

level-discipline.because: This file enforces it: every row declares its level, and no row carries a whole-animal fold-shift. But the discipline is imposed here, not supplied by the literature - the 30000-fold figure and the ~300-fold figure both travel across levels and studies in the sources themselves.
level-discipline.what_would_raise_it: A study that measures cloned channel, muscle fibre and whole animal on the same genotypes. hague_2018 names that study and says it did not do it.

per-substitution-attribution.because: The 260-fold allele carries four substitutions and only two of them are even named in the retrieved text. None of the four amphibian candidates has been expressed individually. The one substitution with a native-background measurement, I1561V, has published effect sizes spanning 1.3 to 5.
per-substitution-attribution.what_would_raise_it: A combinatorial series in the native background, or deep mutational scanning of the pore loops.

mechanistic-convergence.because: geffeney_2022 asked whether positionally convergent substitutions produce convergent TTX-channel interactions and found little evidence that they do, across three metrics. This is the one axis where a retrieved source argues against the premise rather than being silent on it.
mechanistic-convergence.what_would_raise_it: Structures of two lineages' own resistant channels with TTX bound, or mutant-cycle analysis of the same positions in both.

verdict_axes.headline: Quantitative target present and convergence independently established; commensurability across studies and per-substitution attribution both weak; mechanistic convergence actively argued against by a retrieved source. The next experiment is named on each axis.

why_no_fused_scalar.headline: Seven axes, several of them pulling opposite ways, cannot be averaged into a retro-validatability score without a weighting that nobody can defend, and the weighting becomes invisible at the first function call.
the_argument: Two of the axes here are strong and two are absent. A mean of those is a number that describes no state of affairs.
A single float gets read as a probability downstream, and there is no reference class for it to be a probability over.
The weighting that produces the float is a modelling choice made by whoever wrote the weighting, and it stops being visible the moment the float is returned.
The useful output of this file is WHICH axis is absent, because that is what names the next experiment. A score erases exactly that.

band.width_is_the_message: The band spans nearly the whole range because the axes disagree with each other, not because the estimate is imprecise. Collapsing it would hide the disagreement, which is the only interesting thing about it.
band.not_a_probability: There is no reference class of retro-validation cases over which this could be a frequency.

verdict_axes.the_axis_that_decides_the_next_experimen: per-substitution-attribution. It is the only weak axis that a single tractable experiment would move, and moving it would also move cross-study-commensurability and non-additivity at the same time.

space.caveat: Not a ranking, not a search result, and not a base rate. The proportion refused is a property of WHICH hosts and WHICH capabilities were written down here, and both lists were chosen - partly to cover every mechanism class and every verdict class. Reading the refusal fraction as "most designs are impossible" would be reading this module's table of contents as a finding.
space.for: Reading a column to see which hosts a capability can even be asked of, and reading a row to see which capabilities a host can even be asked for - with the reason attached to every cell that is out, so that a refusal can be argued with rather than only obeyed.

pairs.a: Carassius carassius — PDHE1alpha3 (the muscle-dominant pyruvate dehydrogenase E1-alpha paralogue, acting as a pyruvate decarboxylase)
pairs.b: Danio rerio — pdha1a + pdha1b (the two-gene E1-alpha set)
pairs.note: The donor trait is survival of months of anoxia by converting pyruvate to acetaldehyde and then to ethanol in skeletal muscle, which diffuses out across the gills instead of accumulating as lactate (Fagernes 2017). The mechanism is a duplicated E1-alpha/E1-beta pair that detached from the rest of the complex: the paper attributes the detachment to a beta-D319N substitution in E1beta2 that raises the E1-E2 dissociation constant, plus a W382 substitution in the dominant muscle E2 paralogue, and reports NO additional substitution in E1alpha that would alter its structure or kinetics. So the donor side's functional change does not live in the E1-alpha catalytic module at all - which is the gene this pair is about. pairs.a: Chaenocephalus aceratus — adult alpha/beta-globin locus (beta-globin gene deleted; of alpha1 only part of intron 2, exon 3 and the 3-prime UTR retained, transcriptionally inactive)
pairs.b: Danio rerio — globin gene clusters (17 annotated genes: 13 on chromosome 3, 4 on chromosome 12)
pairs.note: A GENE LOSS pair, entered to find out whether this module's vocabulary can express one. It cannot, and that is the row's value - see LOSS_IS_NOT_IN_THE_VOCABULARY. The biology is among the best-characterised losses in vertebrates: the channichthyids are described as the only adult vertebrates with no functional haemoglobin, the beta-globin gene is gone from three species tested by Southern blot (Cocca 1995), the surviving alpha1 remnant has been sequenced to the exon (Zhao 1998), the embryonic/juvenile globin genes are gone too (di Prisco 2002), and the proposed cause is a single large deletion in the ancestral channichthyid. All of that enters this schema as seven absences, because every evidence kind is a predicate on evidence FOR a correspondence and none can carry a measured absence. pairs.a: Astyanax mexicanus (Pachon cave population, Lineage 2) — eye-regression developmental programme
pairs.b: Astyanax mexicanus (Molino cave population, Lineage 1) — eye-regression developmental programme
pairs.note: Convergence WITHIN one species: same genome, same gene pool, two colonisations of caves from at least two different surface lineages (Richards 2026, PMID 41676532), the same outcome. Every confound that usually wrecks a convergence comparison is held constant by construction, so this is the cleanest place in the repo to ask whether two lineages used the same loci. The live records answer partly: NINE eye-size QTL regions are associated with cave genotypes from both lineages, which is the highest genetic repeatability among the traits examined - and a selective-sweep scan over 2,433 genes inside QTL regions found only TWO genes under selection in all three wild cave populations, both of them in lineage-unique, non-eye QTL. So the question is settled at the level of REGIONS and open at the level of GENES. Bradic 2013 (PMID 23927992) adds a third possibility that neither "same mutation" nor
pairs.headline: Strongest evidence present: loss-of-function phenotype similarity, which is a correlate of function and not a test of it. Absent: rescue / cross-species complementation; sequence orthology (with homology type); conserved synteny (genomic neighbourhood); expression-domain similarity; protein-domain architecture. Support for the functional claim is moderate, and the band straddles the boundary between weak and moderate and strong, so even the word is not resolved. No direct functional test exists for this pair.

pairs.a: Astyanax mexicanus (Pachon cave population) — eye-regression programme: expanded midline shha/shhb signalling driving lens apoptosis
pairs.b: Nannospalax galili / Spalax ehrenbergi superspecies — subcutaneous rudimentary eye
pairs.note: Both lineages reduced an eye in the dark, and that is where the similarity stops. The Spalacid rodent was chosen over Heterocephalus glaber on record depth measured live - PubMed returned 28 records for `Spalax eye` and 9 for `Heterocephalus glaber eye` - and that is a reason for a CHOICE, not a finding. The ocular literature is on the Spalax ehrenbergi superspecies; the gene records are on Nannospalax galili, which NCBI Taxonomy (taxid 1026970) lists under the synonym Nannospalax ehrenbergi galili, and that nomenclatural link is all that joins the two bodies of evidence on this side. The mammalian side is histological, ultrastructural and comparative-genomic. There is no gene knockout, no embryonic signalling-domain comparison against a sighted relative, and no complementation. Three evidence kinds are therefore absent, the module bands the pair low, and the band is the honest output. S
pairs.headline: Strongest evidence present: protein-domain architecture, which is a correlate of function and not a test of it. Absent: rescue / cross-species complementation; loss-of-function phenotype similarity; conserved synteny (genomic neighbourhood); expression-domain similarity. Support for the functional claim is weak, and the band straddles the boundary between no-support and weak and moderate, so even the word is not resolved. No direct functional test exists for this pair.

pairs.note: Two reversible, stress-resistant developmental arrests separated by most of animal evolution, each with its own gene programme, and - the part that makes the pair worth a dossier - with a genuinely SHARED, genuinely TESTED node: the forkhead box O transcription factor. pairs.note: INCLUDED AS A NEGATIVE CONTROL for killifish-diapause-dauer, and recorded as such before the module was run on it. Its purpose is to find out whether a band from analogy.mjs carries information, which it cannot do unless a pair with genuinely absent evidence lands somewhere different from a pair with genuinely present evidence. The two arrests share a word and little else. The fish arrest interrupts EMBRYONIC development (hu_2020). The insect arrest is an ADULT, reproductive state - schmidt_2008 describes "a reproductive diapause that is variable within and among populations", i.e. an adult whose ovaries stop, not an embryo that stops developing. pairs.note: The pair that is orthologous AND convergent at once, which is the case analogy.mjs treats as two alternatives. The duplication that created scn4aa is SHARED and ancient - Zakon 2006 places it "early in teleost evolution, likely the result of a genomewide duplication", and Arnegard 2010 states the co-option happened "more than 100 million years following the origin of Scn4aa by duplication" - so what each lineage did independently is RECRUIT a pre-existing spare copy into a novel organ, not invent a gene. Both halves of that are true of this pair simultaneously, and the classifier can report only one: with sequence-orthology present it takes the orthology branch and returns orthologous-untested, which is correct by its own rules and omits the entire reason the pair is interesting. pairs.a: Sternopygus macrurus — electrocyte (electric organ current-producing cell)
pairs.b: Sternopygus macrurus — skeletal muscle fibre (striated myofibre)
pairs.note: A CELL-TYPE pair, entered to find out whether analogy.mjs can speak about one at all. Both sides are the same species on purpose: the comparison the primary literature actually measured is electric organ versus muscle in one fish, and taking both sides from S. macrurus removes the cross-species tissue-vocabulary confound that analogy.mjs flags for the expression-domain kind. pairs.note: The pair where the experiment has already been done. Pigs carry a UCP1 locus with exons 3 to 5 removed by a deletion dated to about 20 million years ago, plus three further disrupting mutations in what remains, and piglets appear to lack brown adipose tissue and rely on shivering (Berg 2006). axes.question: Does the system emit a NUMBER with units that a measurement could contradict?

vocabulary.NUMBER_WITH_UNITS: a value and a unit are stated, so a single measurement with a stated threshold can contradict the design
vocabulary.DIRECTION_ONLY: a sign is stated - larger, faster, more tolerant - with no magnitude, so only a wrong-direction result refutes it, and a tiny right-direction result confirms it trivially
vocabulary.NO_COMMITMENT: no number and no direction. Nothing can contradict it, which means nothing can support it either

axes.question: Is there a PUBLISHED assay that reads out this phenotype, with a citation we have actually retrieved?

vocabulary.PUBLISHED_ASSAY: a retrieved citation reads out this phenotype in a comparable preparation; the protocol exists and has been through review
vocabulary.ASSAY_NEEDS_ADAPTING: an assay exists for the quantity but not in this host, or not at this scale, or the citation for it has not been retrieved - so the readout itself is a development project with its own failure modes
vocabulary.NO_KNOWN_ASSAY: nothing published reads this out. The design cannot be wrong in public until the instrument exists

axes.question: Does ALREADY-PUBLISHED data decide it, with no new experiment?

vocabulary.DECIDABLE_FROM_PUBLISHED_DATA: a dataset in the literature contains the comparison; reading it settles the prediction in one direction or the other
vocabulary.NEEDS_NEW_MEASUREMENT: published data does not contain the comparison, but a stated measurement would settle it
vocabulary.UNDECIDABLE_EITHER_WAY: as posed, neither published data nor the proposed measurement settles it. The claim is not yet of a decidable shape and needs reformulating, not funding

axes.question: In the HOST organism, can the perturbation actually be made and the readout actually be taken?

vocabulary.ROUTINE_IN_HOST: the perturbation and the readout are standard practice in this host; a competent laboratory does this already
vocabulary.POSSIBLE_IN_HOST: it has been done in this host or a close relative, but it is a project rather than a protocol
vocabulary.NOT_TRACTABLE_IN_HOST: no established route to the perturbation or the readout in this host. The design is about an organism nobody can presently work in

axes.question: How long until the evidence exists? Reported as a BAND, never a date.

vocabulary.DAYS: a reanalysis, or a readout on an existing preparation
vocabulary.WEEKS: a readout within one round of culture or rearing
vocabulary.MONTHS: the readout needs animals grown to a stage, or a cohort assembled
vocabulary.YEARS: the readout is a lifespan, a cohort outcome, or a field season sequence
vocabulary.GENERATIONS: the readout needs a stable line, selection, or inheritance across generations. Treated specially: this is where designs quietly stop being testable by the people who proposed them

axes.question: What ELSE could produce the same readout, and can the experiment tell them apart?

vocabulary.CONFOUNDS_NAMED_AND_SEPARABLE: the rival causes are listed, and the design contains the contrast that separates ours from each of them
vocabulary.CONFOUNDS_NAMED_NOT_SEPARABLE: the rival causes are listed and at least one cannot be separated by this experiment. The readout will move or not move and the cause will remain open
vocabulary.CONFOUNDS_UNENUMERATED: nobody has written down what else makes this readout move. The result is uninterpretable in advance of being collected

axes.question: Is there a design that SHOULD fail, so that a pass means something?

vocabulary.NEGATIVE_CONTROL_SPECIFIED: a concrete construct, genotype or condition is named that ought to produce no effect, and it is in the plan
vocabulary.NEGATIVE_CONTROL_CONCEIVABLE: a negative control could be built and has not been specified. A to-do, not a blocker
vocabulary.NO_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: nothing in the design could fail. A pass carries no information, so the experiment cannot validate anything

why_not_a_score.headline: The seven axes are not averaged, because an average would let a design buy its way past the axis that decides whether it is a claim at all.
the_argument: The axes are not commensurable. One is about the grammar of the prediction, one about the existence of an instrument, one about whether a dataset already exists, one about an organism's husbandry, one about elapsed time, one about causal identification, one about whether anything in the design could fail. There is no unit they share and nothing to add up.

Averaging is defeated by its own best case. A design with six excellent axes and NO_COMMITMENT on the first would score high and be unfalsifiable. That is not a near miss to be handled by a penalty term; it is a different kind of object, and a mean cannot represent the difference between "nearly testable" and "not a proposition".

The blocking axes are conjunctive, not additive. A published assay does not compensate for an intractable host; a tractable host does not compensate for an inseparable confound. Each link has to hold for the chain from claim to contradiction to exist, so the right operation over them is AND, and AND is not a weighted sum.

One number hides WHICH link is broken, and the broken link is the entire actionable content. NOT_YET_DECIDABLE because no instrument exists and NOT_YET_DECIDABLE because the host cannot be transformed are the same tier and completely different projects, and a scalar erases the difference at the first function call.

A number between zero and one is read as a probability of being right. This module is not about being right. A design can be maximally validatable and false, which is the best possible state for a design to be in, and a float would make that state look bad.

And this project in particular has no licence to emit fused scores. Two of its three benchmarked levels came out at chance against external ground truth, so a fused number from here would be a confident-looking summary produced by machinery already measured as uninformative. See THE_UNCOMFORTABLE_PART.
why_not_a_score.what_is_returned_instead: a per-axis verdict from a closed vocabulary; one tier from a closed set of four, named by the rule that produced it with that rule's one-line justification; the list of blocking axes; and caveats for the axes that did not change the tier but change what a pass would mean.
why_not_a_score.if_you_need_to_rank: Rank on the TIERS, which are ordered by how soon a refutation could arrive - retro now, lab next, not yet, refused. Within a tier, rank by the blocker, not by a number, and state the ranking in the artefact that consumes it rather than asking this module to invent one quietly.

the_uncomfortable_part.headline: In this project's own benchmarks, two of the three levels came out at chance against external ground truth. So a claim about the VALIDATABILITY of a design is currently a far stronger claim than any claim about the QUALITY of the design, and this module is the only one in the folder whose output does not route through the machinery that scored at chance.

the_numbers.note: Read from benchmarks/README.md in this working tree on 2026-11-07. These are our own results, not any paper's.
the_numbers.guide_score: the score the editing planner ranks by, against measured activity for 307 measured laboratory-fish guides: Spearman rho = -0.037, confidence interval [-0.149, 0.073], which includes zero
the_numbers.design_scorer: AUC 0.891 against shuffled decoys, falling to 0.536 - chance - against real organisms nudged a quarter of a standard deviation; and an anatomically impossible constructed animal placed at q = 0.918, which the scorer calls typical
the_numbers.law_coverage: 1 of 48 laws in the registry expressible as a constraint on the design representation; the worst violator sits at q = 0.347, more typical than 87.1% of real fish
the_numbers.the_one_that_passed: the machine-checked layer: 48/48 witnesses checked, 1 mutant refuted, control behaves
the_numbers.the_line_from_the_file: Two of the three levels come out at chance against external ground truth. One passes.

what_follows_from_it: When this repo says a design is good, that sentence is produced by scorers whose discrimination against hard negatives has been measured at chance. It is not evidence. Treat it as a shortlist drawn by an uncalibrated instrument.

When this module says a design is RETRO_VALIDATABLE_NOW, that sentence is about the existence of a published dataset, a stated threshold and a named rival. It can be checked by anyone, today, without trusting any scorer here.

So validatability currently carries more information than quality, and the ordering is the opposite of the one a design pipeline naturally reports. The correct output of this project, right now, is a ranked list of ways it could be shown to be wrong - not a ranked list of organisms.

This also sets the priority. Getting the design scorer above chance on hard negatives is worth more than any number of further designs, and the only way anyone will know whether it has happened is a retro-decidable prediction written before looking. That is what prereg() is for, and why written_before_looking cannot be defaulted.
the_uncomfortable_part.the_sharpest_instance: The single retro-test available to us bears on this project's central gene nomination, and the repo records that the published comparative signal matches other loci and not ours. That record is kept, labelled POST_HOC because the paper was read before the prediction was written, and reported in worked() as the uncomfortable row. A validatability module whose own worked set contained only tests it passes would be an advertisement.
the_uncomfortable_part.not_an_excuse: None of this licenses vagueness. The response to uncalibrated scorers is sharper thresholds and cheaper refutations, not softer language. Every design in DESIGNS states what would refute it or throws when asked to pretend.
